idea: How to detect a leaking toilet
title: The Simple Dye Test for Silent Toilet Leaks
description: A toilet can leak hundreds of gallons of water a day down the drain without making a sound. To catch a silent flapper leak, try the simple dye test. Remove the tank lid and squeeze a few drops of dark food coloring directly into the water inside the tank. Do not flush. Wait about fifteen to twenty minutes, then check the toilet bowl. If colored water has seeped down into the bowl, your flapper valve or flush valve seal is worn out and needs to be replaced. Catching this early saves water and lowers your utility bill. If replacing the flapper doesn't stop the leak, consult a licensed plumber.
